+import pytest
+
+from jsonschema import Draft201909Validator, Draft202012Validator
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("Validator", [Draft201909Validator, Draft202012Validator])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["x", "type", "properties"])
+def test_successful_additional_values_are_evaluated(Validator, name):
+    schema = {
+        "additionalProperties": {"type": "integer"},
+        "unevaluatedProperties": False,
+    }
+    assert list(Validator(schema).iter_errors({name: 1})) == []
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["x", "type"])
+def test_failed_additional_values_remain_uncovered(name):
+    schema = {
+        "additionalProperties": {"type": "integer"},
+        "unevaluatedProperties": False,
+    }
+    errors = list(Draft201909Validator(schema).iter_errors({name: "bad"}))
+    assert len(errors) == 2
+    ordinary = [error for error in errors if error.validator == "type"]
+    assert len(ordinary) == 1
+    assert list(ordinary[0].path) == [name]
+    assert list(ordinary[0].schema_path) == ["additionalProperties", "type"]
+    uncovered = [
+        error for error in errors if error.validator == "unevaluatedProperties"
+    ]
+    assert len(uncovered) == 1
+    assert repr(name) in uncovered[0].message
+
+
+def test_only_failed_extras_are_reported_as_unevaluated():
+    schema = {
+        "additionalProperties": {"type": "integer"},
+        "unevaluatedProperties": False,
+    }
+    instance = {"good": 1, "bad": "no", "type": "no"}
+    errors = list(Draft201909Validator(schema).iter_errors(instance))
+    assert sorted(
+        list(error.path) for error in errors if error.validator == "type"
+    ) == [["bad"], ["type"]]
+    uncovered = [
+        error for error in errors if error.validator == "unevaluatedProperties"
+    ]
+    assert len(uncovered) == 1
+    assert "'bad'" in uncovered[0].message
+    assert "'type'" in uncovered[0].message
+    assert "'good'" not in uncovered[0].message
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("Validator", [Draft201909Validator, Draft202012Validator])
+def test_declared_and_pattern_matched_values_are_not_additional(Validator):
+    schema = {
+        "properties": {"declared": {"type": "string"}},
+        "patternProperties": {"mid": {"type": "string"}},
+        "additionalProperties": {"type": "integer"},
+        "unevaluatedProperties": False,
+    }
+    instance = {"declared": "text", "prefix_mid_suffix": "text", "x": 1}
+    assert list(Validator(schema).iter_errors(instance)) == []
+
+
+def test_uncovered_failed_extra_is_checked_by_unevaluated_schema():
+    schema = {
+        "additionalProperties": {"type": "integer"},
+        "unevaluatedProperties": {"const": "allowed"},
+    }
+    errors = list(Draft201909Validator(schema).iter_errors({"type": "bad"}))
+    assert sorted(error.validator for error in errors) == [
+        "type", "unevaluatedProperties",
+    ]
+    allowed = list(
+        Draft201909Validator(schema).iter_errors({"type": "allowed"}),
+    )
+    assert [error.validator for error in allowed] == ["type"]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "extra_schema, valid",
+    [({}, False), ({"additionalProperties": True}, True),
+     ({"additionalProperties": False}, False)],
+)
+def test_absent_and_boolean_additional_properties(extra_schema, valid):
+    schema = dict(extra_schema, unevaluatedProperties=False)
+    assert Draft201909Validator(schema).is_valid({"x": 1}) is valid
+
+
+def test_empty_additional_schema_evaluates_extra_values():
+    schema = {"additionalProperties": {}, "unevaluatedProperties": False}
+    assert Draft201909Validator(schema).is_valid({"x": "anything"})

spec.question:
Correct Draft 2019-09 handling of schema-valued `additionalProperties` when `unevaluatedProperties` is present. In this checkout, `Draft201909Validator` rejects `{"x": 1}` against `{"additionalProperties": {"type": "integer"}, "unevaluatedProperties": false}`, even though the additional value passes its schema.

Successfully validated additional properties must count as evaluated; values that fail that schema must remain uncovered and still be checked by `unevaluatedProperties`. This must also hold when an instance property happens to be named like a schema keyword, such as `type`. Properties declared in `properties` or matched by `patternProperties` must remain excluded from additional-property validation, including regex matches that do not cover the entire property name. Preserve the existing behavior when `additionalProperties` is absent or boolean, preserve ordinary validation errors, and leave Draft 2020-12 behavior unchanged.

Return a unified diff against production files only, without changing tests.
